blind_target.authors: Brennan, Michael, Afroz, Sadia, and Greenstadt, Rachel
blind_target.title: Adversarial stylometry: Circumventing authorship recognition to preserve privacy and anonymity
blind_target.evidence_quote: In this paper, we report on a reproduction and, separately, a replication of the experiment described in Brennan et al. (2012).
blind_target.outcome_quote: The replication study generally confirms the effectiveness of the circumvention techniques reported in the original paper.
blind_target.outcome_computational_quote: The chosen polynomial SVM has an average accuracy of 82.1% in attributing authorship given 40 candidates (the largest candidate-pool size in our settings; 10-fold cross-validation)—virtually identical to the accuracy reported in the original study.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Mixed-method paper: classified as replication because it includes a new participant sample, with one entry for its single original paper. The results explicitly provide an overall confirmation verdict; reversal of the ordering of the two methods and reduced estimated effectiveness do not override it. Reproduction axes also retained: one baseline is virtually identical, but the narrative does not establish numerical recovery across the entire central reproduction. Added feature/model specifications are described, but no self-contained verdict establishes robustness of the original-data conclusion across those alternatives.
